description: Verifies the post-Newtonian spin precession of a binary: both precession angular velocities point along the orbital angular momentum and each spin derivative is orthogonal to its spin, so the spin magnitudes are conserved.

checks.label: the precession angular velocity of the first body has a positive component along the orbital axis
the precession angular velocity of the second body has a positive component along the orbital axis
the first spin derivative is orthogonal to the first spin relative to their norms
the second spin derivative is orthogonal to the second spin relative to their norms
